title: Allow me to presenting the (my) unofficial soundtrack to The Mall World
content: [Dazzeland](https://open.spotify.com/album/3cswV4psxgpTBkMVXusABE) was an amusement park housed in the top two floors of a towering shopping centre in my hometown of Adelaide, South Australia, between 1991-98. That building, the Myer Centre, still stands in the centre of our city, and when we're not locked down I walk past it almost every day. But the space where the park existed is now an abandoned ruin locked away from the public. This album is my way of saying I love you, I miss you, and that I'll dream about you until my mind, like the titular Mall World, abandons the top floor of my own body. PS* the link above goes to Spotify but if you want the full experience, there's a dreamlike short story of me recollecting my first visit on the [full album here](https://kintsugist.bandcamp.com/album/dazzeland) via my Bandcamp page.
